title: Especialista em Performance Web Front-End
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Performance Web Front-End apaixonado(a) por otimizar a velocidade, a responsividade e a experiência do usuário das nossas aplicações web. O foco principal é garantir o carregamento ultrarrápido das páginas, melhorar as métricas de Core Web Vitals e aplicar as melhores práticas de SEO Técnico, resultando em melhor posicionamento nos mecanismos de busca e aumento nas taxas de conversão.


Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

- Analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance no Front-End (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imagens, fontes).

- Focar na melhoria contínua das métricas Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) e outras métricas de velocidade (TTFB, FCP, TTI).

- Implementar técnicas de otimização como code splitting, lazy loading, pré-carregamento de recursos (preloading/prefetching), compressão (Gzip/Brotli) e caching avançado.

2. SEO Técnico e Carregamento:

- Garantir a rastreabilidade (crawlability) e indexação eficiente das páginas por bots de mecanismos de busca.

- Otimizar a estrutura do DOM, o uso de HTML semântico e metatags.

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

3. Monitoramento e Análise:

-Utilizar ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Google Search Console e ferramentas de RUM (Real User Monitoring) para monitorar e reportar a performance em ambientes de produção.

-Criar e manter dashboards de performance, identificando tendências e oportunidades de otimização.

4. Colaboração e Educação:

-Colaborar de perto com equipes de Design (UX/UI), Back-End e Marketing/SEO para garantir que as novas funcionalidades sejam lançadas com alta performance e aderência técnica.

-Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e atuar como um mentor técnico, disseminando a cultura de performance para toda a equipe de Front-End.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais (Hard Skills)


• Proficiência em: HTML semântico, CSS (incluindo pré-processadores ou CSS-in-JS) e JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

• Domínio de Frameworks/Bibliotecas: Experiência avançada em pelo menos um dos principais frameworks de Front-End (React, Vue.js ou Angular), com foco na otimização de builds e carregamento.

• Otimização de Assets: Conhecimento profundo em otimização de imagens (WebP, AVIF, tag), font loading (FOIT, FOUT) e minificação de código.

• Ferramentas de Build/Bundling: Experiência com ferramentas como Webpack, Rollup ou Vite, configurando otimizações para produção.

• Infraestrutura/Rede: Entendimento de redes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3), Content Delivery Networks (CDN) e estratégias de cache no navegador e no servidor.

• SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em Sitemap, Robots.txt, canonicalização, dados estruturados (Schema.org) e experiências de usuário mobile.


Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


• Foco em Resultados: Orientação clara para melhorias mensuráveis (KPIs) de performance e SEO.

• Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas que atravessam múltiplas camadas (navegador, rede, servidor, código).

• Comunicação: Habilidade para explicar problemas técnicos complexos e as soluções propostas para audiências não técnicas (marketing, gestão).

• Aprendizado Contínuo: Manter-se atualizado com as constantes mudanças nos algoritmos de busca e nas tecnologias de otimização web.


Diferenciais

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Mid/Senior)
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re looking for a versatile Full-Stack Engineer to join our team. While we’re primarily seeking professionals comfortable working across the stack, from building Vue.js + TypeScript interfaces to developing Kotlin/Spring Boot APIs with PostgreSQL, we also welcome candidates with strong Frontend or Backend experience who are eager to collaborate in a full-stack environment.


What you will do :

  • Design and implement full-stack features and applications.
  • Develop and maintain REST APIs using Kotlin/Spring Boot.
  • Build intuitive, responsive UIs with Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Work with PostgreSQL to design efficient schemas and queries.
  • Ensure high-quality code through testing (Playwright) and code reviews.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
  • Participate in system design and architecture discussions.


What we expect from you :

Mid-Level Engineers

  • Experience with Kotlin/Spring Boot for backend development.
  • Proficiency with Vue.js and TypeScript for frontend development.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs and databases.
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows.
  • Good English communication skills.


Senior Engineers

  • Deep expertise across backend and frontend, able to design end-to-end systems.
  • Strong architectural knowledge focused on scalability and performance.
  • Experience mentoring peers and leading technical discussions.
  • Ability to balance priorities across the stack.
  • Good English communication skills.


Differential requirements:

  • Experience with Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools like Prometheus or Grafana.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Pleno/Senior 1
description:
Quer fazer parte da empresa que está transformando o ecossistema de fintechs no Brasil e fazer parte de projetos criativos e desafiadores ?


Estamos contratando desenvolvedores Fullstack Pleno/Sênior I

Buscamos um profissional com perfil colaborativo, interesse em aprender e crescer profissionalmente, com boas habilidades de comunicação. Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações web em React.js e Node.js , garantindo qualidade e performance.
  • Criar e manter APIs RESTful bem estruturadas e integrá-las ao frontend.
  • Colaborar com backend, produto e UX/UI para entregar soluções consistentes.
  • Contribuir com boas práticas de desenvolvimento e revisões de código.
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e apoiar na evolução da arquitetura do produto.


 Requisitos:

  • Experiência prática com React.js (Hooks, Context API).
  • Bom domínio de JavaScript (ES6+) e TypeScript.
  • Experiência com Node.js (Express, NestJS ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e/ou NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Experiência em HTML5, CSS3 e design responsivo.
  • Consumo de APIs REST e uso de Git para versionamento.
  • Familiaridade com testes básicos (unitários e integração).


 Diferenciais

  • Experiência com SSR (Next.js).
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e deploy em cloud.
  • Noções de segurança em APIs e autenticação/autorização.
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis e trabalho em squads.

title: Administrative Analyst
description:
We are looking for an Operations Admin to support our Central Operations team and US Operations markets in general administrative tasks and onboarding growth. If you are a well organized, analytical person with exceptional communication and problem solving skills then this role may be for you!



What You’ll Focus On:

  • Support our US Operations Cities on growth deliverables and efficiencies in our day to day work and operations
  • Automations for our ways of working when it comes to growth and portfolio changes
  • Analyze data in order to create and prepare detailed reports for the leadership team that effectively communicate trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data
  • Standardize our ways of working across markets to improve timeliness and execution on furnishings and move-outs
  • Perform audits and improve data metrics for our guests and internal teams, as well as manage timely data collection to update productivity and achievements on projects
  • Unit/Building/Process information entry, ensuring all fields are accurately filled and clear for other teams
  • Collaborate with operational team members and organizational leaders to identify gaps and opportunities for process improvements
  • Communicate with third party vendors and companies if needed to support OPS/CX operations
  • Specific admin support related to onboarding and move-out of units for our US cities including:
  • Complete utility and telecommunication setups for new units with third party companies (create online portals, set up payments, and input data into our internal system)
  • Complete Package Setups for new units (create online portals, set up payments, and input data into our internal system)
  • Cancel utility and telecommunication accounts for move-outs
  • Support the scheduling of furnishing and onboarding tasks and move-outs:
  • Communicate with third party vendors and buildings to schedule pick ups
  • Input data into our system related to our properties
  • Track disposal and data related to move-outs
  • Support Central Operations, OPS local team, and finance/accounting with ad-hoc projects



What we are looking for:

  • Degree from a top-tier university
  • Min. 1-2 years of experience in a similar role (administrative experience in residential or hospitality experience will be considered as a plus)
  • Fluency in English
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel (formulation, data entry, charts, pivot tables) and Powerpoint
  • Self-starter with a roll up your sleeves mentality and high attention to detail
  • Entrepreneurial drive, adaptability, and focus on results
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and with speed

title: Profissional Analista Desenvolvedor BPM
description:
Código da vaga:53870


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Experiência Desenvolvedor BPM, para atuar no suporte a operação.

Analisar, mapear e otimizar processos de negócios utilizando a plataforma IBM BAW .

Trabalhar na modelagem de processos e identificar oportunidades de automação e melhoria contínua.

Desenvolver integrações entre o IBM BAW e sistemas externos.

Garantir a qualidade e a conformidade das soluções, com foco em desempenho e escalabilidade.

Documentar processos, fluxos de trabalho e integrações realizadas.



CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Experiência Desenvolvedor BPM, para atuar no suporte a operação.

Analisar, mapear e otimizar processos de negócios utilizando a plataforma IBM BAW .

Trabalhar na modelagem de processos e identificar oportunidades de automação e melhoria contínua.

Desenvolver integrações entre o IBM BAW e sistemas externos.

Garantir a qualidade e a conformidade das soluções, com foco em desempenho e escalabilidade.

Documentar processos, fluxos de trabalho e integrações realizadas.



CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Analista de Atendimento Cliente | Sala VIP
description:
Sobre a Quero Passagem

Somos um marketplace digital de passagens e viagens com a missão de conectar pessoas a destinos de forma prática, segura e ágil em todo o Brasil. Inovamos constantemente para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos clientes, estimulando a criatividade como motor de transformação no setor de turismo.


A Oportunidade

Já pensou em fazer parte de um ambiente dinâmico, que conecta milhares de pessoas ao redor do país? Estamos em busca de um Analista de Atendimento ao Cliente para atuar na nossa Sala VIP , localizada no Terminal Rodoviário Tietê, em São Paulo. Aqui, você será o rosto da Quero Passagem para os nossos viajantes, oferecendo acolhimento, suporte e uma experiência diferenciada antes do embarque. Se você gosta de gente, tem brilho no olhar e paixão por atendimento, queremos te conhecer!


O que você fará?

  • Recepcionar e acolher os clientes da Sala VIP, garantindo um atendimento cortês, empático e eficiente;
  • Fornecer informações detalhadas sobre o funcionamento da Sala VIP , serviços disponíveis, horário de embarque e facilidades locais;
  • Oferecer suporte em dúvidas relacionadas a passagens, remarcações e embarques , buscando sempre soluções ágeis e assertivas;
  • Manter o ambiente organizado e agradável , zelando pela estética e conforto do espaço;
  • Gerenciar o estoque de snacks e bebidas , assegurando o abastecimento e a qualidade dos itens oferecidos;
  • Atuar em parceria com outras áreas da empresa para garantir uma comunicação clara e um atendimento alinhado com os valores da Quero Passagem ;
  • Ter atenção especial a passageiros com necessidades especiais, demonstrando sensibilidade e preparo para oferecer um atendimento acessível.

title: Analista Ciência da Medição Pleno
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista Ciência da Medição Pleno



Resumo:

Pessoa será responsável por garantir a manutenção dos produtos e processos correntes, atuando também continuamente em busca de melhorias metodológicas, processuais e em qualidade. Além disso, se posiciona como ponto focal para atendimento de dúvidas dos times de Produto, Operações e Comercial, suportando também testes, documentações e estudos de novos processos.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Promover a contínua comunicação com os principais stakeholders internos para a manutenção dos critérios técnicos na sustentabilidade dos processos recorrentes nos produtos.
  • Garantir em metodologia e execução a manutenção de processos já validados e em operação nos produtos em que o time possui atuação.
  • Atuar nas inclusões, revisões e atualizações metodológicas propostas pelo time e/ou demandadas por Produto e Comercial dos processos relacionados com métodos de integração de dados para os produtos do Portfólio.
  • Mapear, desenvolver e apoiar o desenvolvimento de análises e testes de novos processos dos produtos de Audiência de TV e Cross Media.
  • Propor e desenvolver controles de qualidade com o objetivo de garantir e certificar o pleno funcionamento de etapas de processos internos e/ou externos associados aos produtos e cobertos pelo escopo do time.
  • Mapear oportunidades em que a automação pode promover melhora significativa na qualidade e/ ou eficiência de processos.
  • Propor e desenvolver técnicas e aplicações de automação para atividades recorrentes na equipe ou executadas por áreas de interface e que impactem os processos da equipe.
  • Monitorar de forma contínua o mercado de Inteligência Artificial, com objetivo de identificar e implementar soluções que visem inovação, melhoria e/ou eficiência.
  • Fomentar de forma constante a inovação e melhoria contínua em temas relacionados à área, estando constantemente ativo na busca e curadoria de novas práticas e aberto a ouvir propostas de outros membros da equipe.
  • Contribuir para o crescimento de cada membro da equipe, estando sempre disponível para troca de ideias, explicações e compartilhamento de conhecimento.




O que buscamos?

  • Formação Superior em Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável experiência na indústria de publicidade e/ou mídia.
  • Fundamental experiência em linguagens de programação como Python e R.
  • Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados integradas ao Python, R ou como o Power BI.
  • Desejável conhecimento em plataformas para uso de dados em nuvem, como Azure Databricks.
  • Desejável conhecimento e interesse em soluções acionáveis de Inteligência Artificial para negócios e dados.
  • Inglês intermediário fundamental, para leitura, escrita e conversação.
  • Espanhol desejável.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua




Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!




Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: VAGA CIM-TEAM - Engenheiro(a) de Vendas Técnicas | Especialista em Soluções
description:
Especialista em Soluções de Engenharia (Vendas) | Home Office | CIM-Team (Vaga para residentes em Porto Alegre ou Região Metropolitana)


Descrição: A CIM-Team busca um(a) Engenheiro(a) com perfil comercial para uma posição estratégica: ser a autoridade técnica e comercial do E3.series, o software de engenharia elétrica de ponta usado por mais de 40 mil engenheiros no mundo.

Seu papel vai além da venda. Você será o especialista que visita (mesmo que virtualmente) grandes indústrias, entende seus gargalos de engenharia e apresenta soluções de alto impacto.


Suas responsabilidades-chave:

  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vendas de A a Z (prospecção, demonstração técnica, negociação e fechamento).
  • Atuar como consultor(a) técnico(a) para clientes no Brasil e América Latina.
  • Ser a ponte técnica direta com os desenvolvedores na Alemanha (Zuken).
  • Gerenciar sua carteira e sucesso de clientes via HubSpot.


O candidato(a) ideal:

  • Engenheiro(a) Eletricista ou de Automação.
  • Já atuou em áreas comerciais (vendas técnicas, pré-vendas, aplicação).
  • Comunica-se bem em inglês (nível técnico).
  • Reside em Porto Alegre ou Região Metropolitana
  • Diferencial de Ouro: Possui formação técnica (Eletrotécnica, Automação, etc.) pré-universitária.
  • Bônus: Fala espanhol.


O que oferecemos:

  • A solidez de uma contratação CLT com a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto.
  • Todo o equipamento necessário para seu home office.
  • Pacote completo de benefícios (Plano de Saúde, Odonto, VA/VR, Auxílio Home Office).
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar com tecnologia de ponta e clientes de renome mundial.


Se você é movido por desafios técnicos e quer crescer em uma empresa líder, queremos conhecer você.

title: Architect
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Architecture Lead to drive the design and execution of brand experiences, pop-ups, permanent retail spaces, and large-scale installations. This role merges creative vision with technical expertise, bridging design, production, and fabrication to deliver exceptional innovative environments. You'll lead projects from concept through construction, providing strategic direction, coordinating cross-disciplinary teams, and serving as the key liaison between creative leadership, production, and fabrication partners.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead multiple projects simultaneously
  • Drive design development from initial concept through detailed construction documentation
  • Establish and maintain design standards, ensuring high-quality, innovative, and functional outcomes
  • Collaborate with producers and project managers to maintain project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Partner with creative directors to understand design intent and translate it into clear architectural strategies
  • Generate daily creative briefs to guide the architecture design team on project direction and next steps
  • Provide real-time feedback, guidance, and mentorship to junior architectural designers throughout the design process
  • Communicate and present complex design ideas clearly to both creative and technical stakeholders
  • Develop precise schematic drawing packages and 3D models in Rhinoceros for vendor and fabricator coordination
  • Ensure all drawings and designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and regulations for domestic and international markets
  • Collaborate directly with engineers, fabricators, and contractors to identify optimal solutions for project execution
  • Review and approve shop drawings and fabrication details prior to production
  • Research, review, and specify appropriate materials and finishes
  • Provide construction oversight to ensure design intent is maintained throughout on-site execution


REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture
  • 8+ years of professional experience in architecture, with proven leadership in design-driven projects
  • Experience with retail, set design, exhibitions, or experiential installations
  • Strong understanding of materials, construction methods, and fabrication processes
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in creating technical drawings and specifications
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills
  • Portfolio demonstrating design excellence and ability to work on projects at different scales
  • Ability to manage fast-paced projects and adapt quickly to shifting priorities
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a team
  • Professional knowledge and use of Rhinoceros is mandatory
  • Proficient in Google Docs suite (Docs, Slides, Spreadsheet)
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign)
  • Ability to quickly learn Cinema 4D and Octane rendering software



ABOUT DE-YAN

DE-YAN is a brand experience studio built to lead the next era of human connection.

We seamlessly fuse creative development, in-house production, and immersive storytelling to create authentic, human-first moments – moments that are proven to build a powerful relationship between brands and their audiences.


With deep roots in fashion, luxury, beauty, and lifestyle, DE-YAN balances concept and craft to create innovative, experience-led creative across five key disciplines: Experiential Design, Motion, Creative Technology, Graphic Design, and Physical Production - all rooted in Creative Strategy and a deep understanding of culture. Our global team of 120+ full-time creatives spans New York, Los Angeles, EU, Brazil, and Canada, allowing us to bring diverse perspectives and rigorous precision to every brief.

title: GenAI Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Software Engineer focused on Artificial Intelligence, you will make a significant contribution to the construction of innovative AI Agents by collaborating closely with your engineering peers. This role requires a high degree of creative thinking and a strong willingness to learn, as you will be working with the latest in Generative AI tools and frameworks. The Agentic AI Engineer explores emerging technologies, promotes new development approaches, and helps shape the standards for intelligent automation, playing a fundamental role in advancing the company's AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of autonomous AI Agents, leveraging LLMs, advanced techniques such as RAG, and agent-specific frameworks;
  • Develop full-stack applications that support and interact with AI Agents, using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Next.js to build the necessary interfaces and systems;
  • Explore and experiment with emerging technologies and frameworks in the agentic space, fostering innovation and shaping best practices;
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to define the behavior, capabilities, and goals of AI Agents, translating business requirements into robust agentic solutions;
  • Ensure code quality through rigorous reviews, testing, and documentation, while mentoring other engineers on development best practices.


Essential Skills

  • Solid experience in software engineering, with proven expertise in writing clean, maintainable code and leveraging modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure quality and automate delivery;
  • Hands-on and up-to-date knowledge of Generative AI, including experience building and implementing features with LLMs in real-world products;
  • Strong foundation in software engineering principles, including system design, API architecture, code quality, and testing.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience in designing GenAI solutions architecture, agent frameworks, and advanced techniques such as RAG;
  • Knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP) applied to production-grade systems;
  • Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, including proficiency with modern frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or CrewAI for the purpose of building, testing, and deploying autonomous, goal-oriented agents.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.


We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

  • Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

title: Analista de Customer Success
description:
Estamos em busca de talentos que queiram crescer junto com a transformação digital.


Se você é movido por desafios, quer se desenvolver profissionalmente em um ambiente dinâmico, tem paixão por criar relacionamentos e interesse genuíno em tecnologia e inovação, essa pode ser a sua próxima grande oportunidade.


Com a rápida evolução das soluções em nuvem e a transformação constante do mercado de tecnologia, o modelo de vendas mudou — e isso exige profissionais adaptáveis, curiosos e dispostos a aprender continuamente. Procuramos Analista de Customer Success com mentalidade de crescimento, que valorizem a construção de relacionamentos, saibam trabalhar em equipe e consigam tratar cada cliente de maneira única e especial.


Você fará parte de um time ágil, focado em resultados e altamente colaborativo.


Se você quer aprender, se desenvolver e crescer em uma empresa que acompanha as mudanças do mercado, envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte dessa jornada com a gente.


Vale a pena conhecer a vaga!


Responsabilidades:


  • Ser resolutivo (a) com os eventuais conflitos em clientes;
  • Entender e conduzir de forma amigável os atendimentos;
  • Estabelecer ótimo relacionamento com os clientes;
  • Análise de números, elaboração de gráficos;
  • Responsável por entender o nível de sucesso dos clientes;
  • Apoio e suporte ao time de vendas.


Qualificações básicas:


  • Gostar de desafios;
  • Amar relacionamento com clientes;
  • Ser excelente ouvinte;
  • Ter bom controle emocional;
  • Experiência prévia como Assistente de Customer Success em empresas de software;
  • Totalmente comprometido com as metas e resultados;
  • Treinável e flexível às mudanças (durante o projeto, será provável a necessidade de novas técnicas, novos produtos, e novas abordagens);
  • Fortemente auto motivável;
  • Facilidade e gosto em conversas telefônicas – uma parte importante do trabalho será reuniões remotas com clientes;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de Customer Success;
  • Pensamento criativo;
  • Empatia (fundamental para esse trabalho);
  • Que seja proativo para trabalhar sozinho buscando seus próprios resultados independente de ajuda e necessidade de supervisão;
  • Saber trabalhar com ferramentas do Office: Word, Excel, Outlook e PowerPoint;
  • Habilidade em conhecer novos métodos de trabalho. Necessidade de entender e aplicar a forma de trabalho da empresa.


Qualificações preferidas não obrigatórias:


  • Nível superior
  • Boas noções Comerciais (Área de Vendas) e/ou Relacionamento com clientes (Customer Success)
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas colaborativas Microsoft.


Experiências prévias desejadas:


  • Atuação em área de Customer Success, mínimo 6 meses.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role: Senior Full Stack Developer (Java Spring Boot | Ruby on Rails | Angular)

Experience: 7+ years

Work location: Heredia, Costa Rica & remote for LATAM

English Required: B2+ - C1

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in Java Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, and Angular to lead complex application development initiatives. The ideal candidate will be a strong technical contributor with a proven track record in building scalable, high-performance systems. While excelling in backend implementation and frontend execution. This role is ideal for a technically strong developer who is ready to expand their impact beyond code delivery into collaborative leadership, stakeholder communication, and architectural decision-making.

Require Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Java Spring Boot and core Java (OOP, data structures, algorithms).
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and full-stack web development.
  • Proven experience with Angular and modern frontend technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js).
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and cloud-native development.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Docker, and deployment automation tools.
  • Effective communication across global teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end development of scalable, secure, and maintainable applications using Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, and Angular .
  • Deliver high-quality code with a strong emphasis on performance, security, and clean architecture .
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, QA teams, and other team members to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Drive technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and standardization across teams.
  • Represent technical solutions and communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executives.
  • Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies in project planning and execution.
  • Contribute to migration projects, system modernization, and platform upgrades with minimal disruption.

title: Atlassian Consultant
description:
Company Description

At Atlas Bench, we are committed to transforming teamwork across industries through innovative Atlassian services. Our global team, proficient in DevOps and ITSM, specializes in agile methodologies and AI solutions tailored for Atlassian products. Serving over 1000 clients, including Fortune 500 companies, we are known for managed licensing, consulting, and AI-driven Atlassian integrations. Our diverse team brings cutting-edge solutions to every project, trusted by leading global firms and reflected in our client success stories.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for an Atlassian Consultant. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Atlassian products such as Jira and Confluence, providing training to clients, and ensuring the smooth integration of Atlassian tools into their workflow. You will also consult on best practices, develop custom solutions to meet client needs, and provide ongoing support and maintenance.

Qualifications
  • Experience with configuring and implementing Atlassian products like Jira, Confluence, and JSM
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps practices and ITSM methodologies
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies and AI solutions for Atlassian tools
  • Skills in providing training and support for Atlassian tools
  • Excellent communication and consulting skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Experience with Fortune 500 clients or large-scale enterprise projects is a plus

title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Product Analyst (Remote, US Central Time Zone Hours)

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will collaborate with the data products team to perform a variety of analytics-related tasks, including creating dashboards, building tables, and conducting in-depth data analyses. This position requires strong experience working in an Azure environment and the ability to work remotely while aligning with US Central Time Zone hours.


This role would be ideal for someone with a strong Data Engineering background who wants to be part of the Data Product team.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.
  • Perform data analysis and data profiling, identifying new data sources to enhance business processes.
  • Develop, refine, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics products to support decision-making.
  • Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including creating test plans based on stakeholder discussions and adapting existing tests for new use cases.
  • Document processes, findings, and methodologies to ensure transparency and reusability.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders.
  • Proven experience in data analysis, data profiling, and delivering analytics solutions.
  • Expertise in SQL.
  • Experience working in an Azure environment.
  • Familiarity with UAT processes, including test creation and execution.
  • Attention to detail and ability to document workflows and findings.



If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for transforming data into actionable insights, we’d love to hear from you.

Qaracter is an international consulting firm specialized in the financial and banking sector. We partner with leading institutions to drive transformation projects across compliance, technology, operations, and risk management.


With a global mindset and strong expertise in financial services, we help our clients face complex challenges and design innovative solutions.


What powers it all? Our people — ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.



What You’ll Do

  • Work with Calypso for system development and support
  • Integrate and manage APIs (REST, FIX, SWIFT, XML)
  • Support the trade lifecycle and related workflows
  • Utilize AWS cloud services and CI/CD practices
  • Develop using Java and SQL


What You Bring

  • Minimum 3 years of experience with Calypso
  • Strong knowledge in API development and support
  • Hands-on experience with Java development and SQL
  • Familiarity with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, FIX, Swift, XML protocols


Location

LATAM (Remote)


Your Benefits at Qaracter

  • Opportunity to work on international financial projects.
  • Flexibility: remote, hybrid, or in-office options depending on the client.
  • Recognition and referral programs.
  • Ongoing learning and training opportunities with reimbursement options.
  • Well-being program and team events.
  • Competitive compensation and top-tier equipment provision.



At QARACTER Group, we are committed to ensuring equal opportunities and non-discrimination in all our processes, promoting an inclusive and diverse work environment. All applications are welcome regardless of sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, age, disability, or any other personal or social condition, in line with our Plan de Igualdad and our commitment to equity.

title: Desenvolvedor D365 F&O (Azure Logic Apps)
description:
Você é apaixonado por construir soluções em nuvem que impulsionam a transformação empresarial? Junte-se à nossa equipe como Desenvolvedor D365 F&O, onde você irá projetar, desenvolver e manter fluxos de trabalho com Azure Logic Apps que viabilizam integrações, migrações de dados e soluções personalizadas para o Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.


Responsabilidades:


• Criar e implantar Azure Logic Apps para automatizar fluxos de trabalho e integrar sistemas.

• Liderar processos ETL para limpeza, mapeamento e migração de dados para o D365 F&O.

• Desenvolver soluções personalizadas em X++ utilizando pipelines do Azure DevOps.

• Criar APIs, conectores e scripts para integração fluida entre aplicativos.

• Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para entregar soluções de alto impacto.

• Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas com Azure Logic Apps.

• Garantir segurança, conformidade e manter documentação detalhada.



Experiência:


• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em automação de fluxos de trabalho em nuvem e integrações de sistemas.

• Forte domínio de Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions e serviços relacionados.

• Compreensão sólida da estrutura de banco de dados do D365 F&O e desenvolvimento em X++.

• Experiência com SQL, SSIS, APIs RESTful e serviços SOAP.

• Habilidade com Azure DevOps, testes/debugging e otimização de desempenho.

• Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas, gestão de tempo e comunicação.

• Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou experiência equivalente.

title: AI Legal Ops Intern
description:
AI Legal Ops Internship at Jumpstart

Location: Remote – Brazil

Compensation: BRL 3,000/month (with growth potential and future equity opportunities)

Hours: 30 per week


About us

We are not just another legal tech startup. We are building the infrastructure to transform the 10-billion-dollar U.S. immigration market, a system that is currently broken, slow and unfair.

Our product utilizes AI to automate legal workflows, predict case outcomes and provide immigrants with something no one else offers: certainty. If their petition is not approved, they get their money back.

We are at the beginning of something massive. We are looking for individuals who want to be part of the journey from 0 to 1, help build a billion-dollar company and own a stake in it.


What We’re Looking For

We do not care if you have worked at a big firm or have a fancy title.

We care if you are:

  • Desperate to learn, willing to move fast, break things and build better.
  • Curious and ambitious, obsessed with the intersection of law, technology and impact.
  • Hungry, driven to help build something huge and take a slice of the upside.
  • Hands-on, ready to work side by side with founders, not sit on the sidelines.


What You’ll Do
  • Collaborate with our legal and AI teams to craft compelling legal petitions and recommendation letters.
  • Structure and organize legal evidence so our AI can produce flawless, high-impact documents.
  • Review and refine AI outputs to ensure legal precision and storytelling excellence.
  • Be part of the core team that is rewriting how immigration is done.


What You Need
  • Law, Computer Science or related degree in progress.
  • Excellent research and writing skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Strong appetite for learning fast, solving problems and building from scratch.
  • Zero ego, high energy.


Why Join Us
  • Be part of a hyper-early-stage company with massive upside.
  • Work directly with founders on a mission to disrupt a trillion-dollar industry.
  • Real ownership and growth, not just busywork.
  • Learn more in six months than most people learn in three years.


This is not a regular internship. If you are hungry, ambitious and want to help build something from the ground up, this is your shot.

title: Head of Email & Retention
description:
Job Title: Head of Email & Retention

Employment type: Contractor – Full-Time Hours

Remote status: Fully remote

Start date: November

Base Salary: $48,000/year + Plus Rev Share (uncapped earnings)


About the Role:

We're expanding Brick’s service offering to include email and retention marketing as a core growth channel - and we're looking for someone highly experienced to build this department from the ground up. This isn't a fulfilment role. It’s a department ownership role.


You’ll be responsible for:

Defining the offer

Setting pricing and packages

Building systems and processes

Hiring freelancers for delivery

Managing client communication and reporting

Driving growth and performance

Scaling the division profitably

Meeting and reporting into Brick's leadership team


You’ll step in as the Head of Email & Retention with the autonomy to shape how this division runs - while having access to an existing roster of eCommerce brands ready to upsell.


What You’ll Own:

title: Solr Engineer
description:
Required Skills:

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Software Engineer required
  • Experience deploying software to the public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Have prior hands-on software development experience (Java/AWS preferred)
  • Experience modernizing large-scale search systems
  • 3+ years working with SOLR


Responsibilites:

  • Lead the transition from legacy SOLR infrastructure to modern, semantic, and hybrid search solutions leveraging AWS. Drive roadmap planning in collaboration with product and ML leadership.
  • Developing Search Algorithms: Implementing advanced search algorithms that can process large datasets quickly and accurately, leveraging search engine features such as vector
  • Performance Tuning: Continuously testing and optimizing the performance of the search engine to improve query response times, accuracy, and relevancy based on defined metrics
  • Collaborate with your Tech Lead, Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and UX to make sure requirements are clear and we’re taking the best technical approaches.
  • Work in a collaborative team environment with a focus on continuous improvement and learning.



Day to Day:

We are looking for a Solr/Search Engineer to join the Search Engine team. Our team is comprised of varying levels of experience and backgrounds. As a Lead Search Engineer in one of our search teams, you can expect to work with other Software Engineers, Architects and Analysts to develop products and deliver solutions in a cloud environment and working with Technical Product Managers by helping with the execution of product roadmaps and backlog priorities. As data volumes grow and user queries become more complex, we need someone with deep expertise in search technologies like Elasticsearch, Apache SOLR, or Lucene to push our infrastructure to the next level.

title: Solr Engineer
description:

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.



At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce)
description:
We are looking for a Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce) who will be responsible for developing complex business needs and providing technical solutions for our Salesforce ecosystem. This person should be flexible to adopt or learn new tools to map the growing business processes as the need arises. This role will report into IT Business Systems team. This role will help positively impact our commercial sales, marketing, agronomy, finance, supply chain, IT & other key business functions with smart, forward-looking solutions and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer, design, develop & support Salesforce Platform (Sales, Service, Marketing/Pardot, Experience Cloud)
  • Take ownership of release cycles to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and code.
  • Develop Apex (classes and triggers), experience building Custom User Interface, including Visualforce pages/Lightning pages, Aura Components and Lightning Web Components.
  • Design and develop sites using Experience Site Builder and customization of experience site interface.
  • Design and develop custom workflows, approval flows as fits the business needs and prepare solution design documents, data flow diagrams, test cases etc. as needed.
  • Adhere to Salesforce best practices, maintain code documentation, and write / maintain test classes for all custom development.
  • Work directly with business (Commercial Sales & Marketing, Agronomy) understanding the business requirements & provide timely and apt solutions.
  • Closely work with extended IT team developers to design, develop, test, implement & support system solutions primarily in Salesforce Platform.


Qualifications and Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on development & design experience with Salesforce Platform is a MUST
  • Experience implementing and developing in Apex, LWC/Aura/Visualforce is a MUST
  • General web development experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript is a MUST
  • Experience working with large data sets, Salesforce API’s and bulkification is a MUST
  • Excellent analytical and debugging skills is a MUST
  • Knowledge of IT SDLC and SOX methodologies is MUST
  • Experience with mobile publisher, Salesforce maps are a big plus
  • Experience with ERP, Datawarehouse, BI/Tableau tools are a big plus
  • Ability to work as part of IT team with clear verbal and written communication
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, and Information Systems is preferred

title: Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce)
description:
We are looking for a Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce) who will be responsible for developing complex business needs and providing technical solutions for our Salesforce ecosystem. This person should be flexible to adopt or learn new tools to map the growing business processes as the need arises. This role will report into IT Business Systems team. This role will help positively impact our commercial sales, marketing, agronomy, finance, supply chain, IT & other key business functions with smart, forward-looking solutions and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer, design, develop & support Salesforce Platform (Sales, Service, Marketing/Pardot, Experience Cloud)
  • Take ownership of release cycles to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and code.
  • Develop Apex (classes and triggers), experience building Custom User Interface, including Visualforce pages/Lightning pages, Aura Components and Lightning Web Components.
  • Design and develop sites using Experience Site Builder and customization of experience site interface.
  • Design and develop custom workflows, approval flows as fits the business needs and prepare solution design documents, data flow diagrams, test cases etc. as needed.
  • Adhere to Salesforce best practices, maintain code documentation, and write / maintain test classes for all custom development.
  • Work directly with business (Commercial Sales & Marketing, Agronomy) understanding the business requirements & provide timely and apt solutions.
  • Closely work with extended IT team developers to design, develop, test, implement & support system solutions primarily in Salesforce Platform.


Qualifications and Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on development & design experience with Salesforce Platform is a MUST
  • Experience implementing and developing in Apex, LWC/Aura/Visualforce is a MUST
  • General web development experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript is a MUST
  • Experience working with large data sets, Salesforce API’s and bulkification is a MUST
  • Excellent analytical and debugging skills is a MUST
  • Knowledge of IT SDLC and SOX methodologies is MUST
  • Experience with mobile publisher, Salesforce maps are a big plus
  • Experience with ERP, Datawarehouse, BI/Tableau tools are a big plus
  • Ability to work as part of IT team with clear verbal and written communication
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, and Information Systems is preferred

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Sales Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary: The Sales Assistant will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
A inovaVoip é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em soluções de comunicação em nuvem e telefonia VoIP. Nosso foco é oferecer plataformas estáveis, seguras e escaláveis, desenvolvidas com tecnologias modernas como React, Next.js, Node.js, Supabase e Docker .

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack para atuar na melhoria e otimização de um sistema já existente , preparando-o para produção e escalabilidade . Buscamos um(a) profissional comprometido(a), com visão técnica, responsabilidade e desejo de crescimento.

Responsabilidades
  • Revisar, higienizar e otimizar o código existente, aplicando boas práticas e padrões de arquitetura.
  • Diagnosticar e corrigir erros, gargalos e falhas de lógica.
  • Aprimorar performance e segurança das principais páginas e fluxos do sistema.
  • Garantir o correto funcionamento de permissões, limites e planos de uso.
  • Preparar o ambiente de execução e deployment utilizando Docker e Docker Compose .
  • Implementar melhorias em integrações Realtime (Supabase, Redis, WebRTC).
  • Colaborar com revisões técnicas e propor soluções estruturadas.
  • Contribuir com documentação e padronização de código.
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Experiência com React (19.x) e Next.js (15.x) .
  • Domínio em TypeScript (5.x) e boas práticas de tipagem.
  • Experiência com Node.js (20.x) e Express.js .
  • Conhecimento em PostgreSQL / Supabase .
  • Experiência com Redis para cache e gerenciamento de sessões.
  • Habilidade em Docker / Docker Compose .
  • Experiência com Git / GitHub .
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e responsabilidade com prazos e entregas.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com WebRTC e Asterisk (VoIP) .
  • Vivência com Supabase Realtime ou Sockets .
  • Conhecimento em TailwindCSS e Radix UI .
  • Familiaridade com Clean Code , SOLID e Design Patterns .
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços e CI/CD .
Perfil Ideal

Buscamos um(a) profissional com senso de responsabilidade, organização e mentalidade de melhoria contínua.

Valorizamos pessoas proativas, com iniciativa e comprometimento em entregar resultados de qualidade, que queiram crescer junto com o projeto e influenciar sua evolução técnica .

Modelo de Trabalho
  • 100% remoto
  • Horário flexível (foco em entregas)
  • Contratação PJ / Freelancer
  • Início imediato

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Angular / Java / SQL)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience using Angular, Java, and SQL to develop analytics dashboard web applications for our industry-leading U.S. client. In this role, you will develop new capabilities in the client's core data product to support its e-commerce service.

Our client is an industry-leading, unified commerce and logistics provider that enables companies with omnichannel commerce capabilities, spanning product discovery to order fulfillment. The company's software, services, and logistics infrastructure serve many of the world's most popular brands, streamlining cross-channel operations and driving more efficient growth. With over 6,000 customers, our client revolutionizes the world of omnichannel commerce.


Responsibilities

  • Build solutions to find actionable insights from data and workflow to act on insights
  • Create APIs and UIs for a web-based analytics dashboard application
  • Deliver high-quality, architecturally sound, extensible code
  • Participate in the architecture, coding, and testing of developed systems
  • Assess requirements, discuss, and debate possible solutions
  • Troubleshoot to find and fix bugs
  • Write unit testing (TDD & BDD) and ensure good code coverage


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills (both verbal and written)
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing software with SQL, Angular, and Java.
  • 3+ years of AWS or other cloud platform experience
  • Experience writing 500+ line analytics SQL queries
  • Extensive experience with Angular and Typescript
  • Experience with Node.js, especially the Nest.js framework
  • Built a data dashboard with dynamic tables and charts
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and with a team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • CI/CD experience with CircleCI, Jenkins, or similar technologies
  • Hands-on experience with Node.js
  • Writing efficient SQL queries for big-data databases, such as Snowflake
  • Experience with container-based systems, such as Docker and AWS ECS
  • Experience with serverless computing, such as AWS Lambda
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and DevOps
  • Data management and analytics experience with dbt, FiveTran, and Looker
  • Experience with e-commerce data or analytics applications


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, learn and grow together!
  • Know your ideas are heard and matter!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with kind, smart, and creative people
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO) per year
  • 8 US holidays, PTO can be used for your local holiday
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Front-End | Hablla
description:
Sobre a Hablla

A Hablla é a plataforma líder em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI) — uma evolução do RevOps que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Business Performance em um único fluxo conversacional.

Nosso propósito é redefinir a comunicação entre marcas e pessoas, utilizando Inteligência Artificial Generativa e automação inteligente para transformar dados em resultados concretos.

Se você busca desafios técnicos, quer trabalhar com produtos digitais de alta escala e participar da construção de uma solução proprietária inovadora essa parceria é para você.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver interfaces modernas e de alta performance utilizando React.js e TypeScript , com foco em escalabilidade, responsividade e experiência do usuário.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Data Scientist altamente qualificado(a) e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de analytics avançado. Nesta função, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar sistemas de recomendação, modelos de previsão de séries temporais e soluções de machine learning baseadas em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para transformar dados em insights acionáveis e soluções escaláveis.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar sistemas de recomendação (filtragem colaborativa, baseada em conteúdo, abordagens híbridas).
  • Construir e validar modelos de previsão de séries temporais utilizando técnicas tradicionais e de machine learning (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, etc.).
  • Implementar algoritmos de boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) e árvores de decisão para diversas tarefas de aprendizado supervisionado.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e engenheiros de ML para implantar modelos em ambientes Azure e Databricks.
  • Realizar exploração de dados, engenharia de features e avaliação de modelos.
  • Apresentar descobertas e modelos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as mais recentes ferramentas e metodologias aplicadas em machine learning.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Matemática, Estatística, Física ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada com sistemas de recomendação e modelos de séries temporais.
  • Sólido conhecimento em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão.
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels.
  • Experiência com serviços em nuvem Azure e Databricks.
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente.
  • Inglês fluente (oral e escrito).

title: Backend Developer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position:

As a Software Engineer in the CORD Team, you will be responsible for implementing all reports and integrations for customers. You will work closely with the various departments in the company including product, solutions, and other teams in the R&D. You will have a main role in onboarding all clients and therefore will have regular communication with customers.


Please apply your CV in English only!


Responsibilities:

  • Working closely with the team lead, and product manager in a cross-functional team currently consisting of developers
  • Closely collaborating with other teams in the R&D department across the organization
  • Take part in all aspects of the development cycle


Requirements:

  • B.Sc degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related domains
  • 5 years experience in hands-on backend development using Python. Alternatively using one or more of Java, C#, or similar language.
  • Experience in Agile Methodology.
  • A great team player and able to function in a fluid environment with minimal guidance and supervision It will be great if you have
  • Proficiency in English is a must.


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.
